descriptionMarkdown:
2 different legendary productivity module 3 factories:

### 1. Using direct upscale from biter eggs.

Notes:
- This blueprint assumes you have all circuits types in **legendary quality** in your logistics network, and also common Bioflux.
- Blueprint includes also the eggs generation. You can remove it if you have your own eggs supply.

### 2. Upscale from raw materials
Notes:
- No legendary items are required but if you have legendary circuits (or other ingridients), the factory will request and use it.
- There is switch marked with signal-skull that when turned on, will ask the logistics network for ALL low tier productivity modules to upscale it as well.

### Updates
- **2025/Nov/10 Update**: Many improvements to the direct upscale version - improved safetly and flood control
- **2025/Feb/23 Update**: Added a second blueprint - Legendary Productivity Module 3 Factory - upscale from raw materials.
title: Legendary Productivity Module 3 Factory
